title: 光片顯微鏡~Light-sheet microscopy
focus: 正交照明、高斯光片厚度與視野、軸向掃描同步、共面對位、散射與折射率失配、多視角資料管線~Orthogonal illumination, Gaussian sheet thickness versus field, axial-sweep synchronization, coplanarity, scattering and index mismatch, multiview data pipelines
summary: 從照明與偵測互相垂直的光路出發，理解光片顯微鏡為何能以極低光劑量做活體與透明化組織的 3D 成像，再把光束腰與瑞利長度、掃描光片與滾動快門同步、偵測取樣、光片共面校正、散射與折射率失配預算、多視角融合與資料管線整合成可交接的光片系統工程。~Start from mutually perpendicular illumination and detection paths to see why light-sheet microscopes image live and cleared samples in 3D at very low light dose, then integrate beam waist and Rayleigh range, scanned sheets synchronized to rolling shutters, detection sampling, sheet coplanarity calibration, scattering and index-mismatch budgets, multiview fusion and data pipelines into a transferable light-sheet system record.

units.anchor: 正交照明與偵測物鏡~Orthogonal illumination and detection
units.title: 正交照明、光學切片與光劑量~Orthogonal illumination, optical sectioning and light dose
units.mechanism: 光片顯微鏡把照明與偵測拆成兩條互相垂直的光路：照明物鏡從側面送入一片薄光，只激發偵測物鏡焦平面附近的螢光，偵測物鏡則以寬場方式一次拍下整個平面。和寬場或共軛焦顯微鏡不同，拍這一層時焦平面外的分子根本沒有被照到，所以光學切片來自照明而不是針孔，整個體積的光劑量與光漂白大幅降低。代價是樣品必須能從側面進光，並放在充滿浸潤液的樣品槽中，與兩支物鏡的工作距離和幾何互相牽制。~A light-sheet microscope splits illumination and detection into two perpendicular paths: an illumination objective sends a thin sheet of light in from the side, exciting fluorescence only near the focal plane of the detection objective, which records the whole plane at once in widefield fashion. Unlike widefield or confocal microscopes, molecules outside the focal plane are simply not illuminated while that plane is recorded, so optical sectioning comes from the illumination rather than a pinhole and the light dose and photobleaching of the whole volume fall sharply. The price is that the sample must admit light from the side and sit in a chamber filled with immersion medium, its geometry constrained by the working distances of two objectives.
units.model: 400 µm 厚樣品以 2 µm 步距取 200 層。寬場每拍一層整個樣品都被照到，每個分子一疊被照 200 次；光片 1/e² 全厚 4 µm 時每個分子只被約 2 層照到。若每次曝光漂白 0.1%（教學假設），寬場一疊後已漂白 1 − 0.999²⁰⁰ ≈ 18%，光片僅約 0.2%；做 100 個時間點，光片累計約 18%，寬場則幾乎完全漂白。~A 400 µm thick sample at a 2 µm step needs 200 planes. In widefield the whole sample is lit for every plane, so each molecule is exposed 200 times per stack; with a light sheet of 4 µm 1/e² full thickness each molecule is lit by only about 2 planes. If each exposure bleaches 0.1% (teaching assumption), one widefield stack bleaches 1 − 0.999²⁰⁰ ≈ 18% while the light sheet bleaches about 0.2%; after 100 time points the light sheet has accumulated about 18% and widefield has bleached almost completely.
units.verify: 以均勻螢光的凝膠或固定樣品，在相同總照明能量下分別以寬場與光片模式重複取 100 疊，量每疊平均強度對次數的衰減並擬合每次曝光的漂白率，比較兩者比值是否接近層數與光片厚度／步距之比；活體樣品則同時記錄細胞分裂速率等生理指標作為光毒性的旁證。~Using a uniformly fluorescent gel or fixed sample at equal total illumination energy, acquire 100 stacks each in widefield and light-sheet mode, measure mean intensity decay versus stack number and fit the bleach rate per exposure, checking that the ratio approaches plane count divided by sheet-thickness-to-step ratio; for live samples also log physiological indicators such as cell-division rate as collateral evidence of phototoxicity.
units.failure: 為了提高訊號把照明功率調高 10 倍並加長曝光，影像更乾淨，但胚胎數小時後發育明顯變慢、細胞分裂停滯；團隊只看影像品質沒有監測生理指標，把光毒性造成的異常當成生物學發現。~To raise signal the illumination power is increased tenfold with longer exposures, the images look cleaner, but after a few hours embryo development slows markedly and cell division stalls; the team watched only image quality, not physiology, and reported a phototoxic artefact as a biological finding.
units.misconception: 光片顯微鏡溫和只是因為用了較弱的雷射。~Light-sheet microscopy is gentle only because it uses a weaker laser.

units.anchor: 高斯光束腰與瑞利長度~Gaussian waist and Rayleigh range
units.title: 光片厚度與視野的取捨~Sheet thickness versus field of view
units.mechanism: 以高斯光束形成的光片最薄處是光束腰 w0，離開腰後依 w(z) = w0·√(1 + (z/z_R)²) 變厚，瑞利長度 z_R = πn·w0²/λ。習慣上把可用視野定為 2z_R，此時邊緣厚度是中心的 √2 倍；由於 z_R 與 w0² 成正比，光片薄一半，可用視野就縮成四分之一。貝索光束與晶格光片以錐狀角譜延長無繞射長度，但貝索光束的旁瓣攜帶大量能量，在焦平面外造成背景與漂白；晶格光片以干涉圖樣壓抑旁瓣，在厚度、視野與旁瓣之間取得不同平衡。~A sheet formed by a Gaussian beam is thinnest at the waist w0 and thickens away from it as w(z) = w0·√(1 + (z/z_R)²), with Rayleigh range z_R = πn·w0²/λ. The usable field is conventionally taken as 2z_R, where the edge thickness is √2 times the centre; because z_R scales with w0², halving the sheet thickness quarters the usable field. Bessel beams and lattice sheets extend the non-diffracting length with a conical angular spectrum, but Bessel side lobes carry much of the energy and cause out-of-focus background and bleaching, while lattice sheets suppress side lobes through interference, striking a different balance among thickness, field and side lobes.
units.model: λ = 488 nm、水中 n = 1.33：w0 = 2 µm 時 z_R = π×1.33×2²/0.488 ≈ 34 µm，視野約 68 µm，中心 FWHM = 1.18w0 ≈ 2.4 µm；w0 = 5 µm 時 z_R ≈ 214 µm，視野約 428 µm，但 FWHM 增為 5.9 µm。若要求 400 µm 視野，w0 = √(z_R·λ/(πn)) = √(200×0.488/(π×1.33)) ≈ 4.8 µm，1/e² 全厚約 9.7 µm。~With λ = 488 nm in water (n = 1.33): w0 = 2 µm gives z_R = π×1.33×2²/0.488 ≈ 34 µm, a field of about 68 µm and a centre FWHM = 1.18w0 ≈ 2.4 µm; w0 = 5 µm gives z_R ≈ 214 µm and a field of about 428 µm, but the FWHM grows to 5.9 µm. Requiring a 400 µm field means w0 = √(z_R·λ/(πn)) = √(200×0.488/(π×1.33)) ≈ 4.8 µm, a 1/e² full thickness of about 9.7 µm.
units.verify: 在螢光素溶液中把光片轉 90° 以偵測相機直接拍光片側影，或在凝膠中取 100 nm 螢光珠的軸向 PSF，於視野多個位置量厚度，擬合 w(z) 求 w0 與 z_R 並與照明 NA 設計值比較；同時確認光束腰的實際位置是否位於視野中央。~In fluorescein solution rotate the sheet by 90° and photograph its profile directly with the detection camera, or take axial PSFs of 100 nm beads in gel, measure thickness at several field positions, fit w(z) to obtain w0 and z_R and compare with the design illumination NA; also confirm that the actual waist lies at the centre of the field.
units.failure: 照明側擴束器被換成較小倍率，照明 NA 降低，w0 由 2 µm 變成 3 µm，視野雖變大，但焦外背景增加使細胞核邊界模糊；因為沒有光片厚度的驗收紀錄，研究者以為是樣品準備問題，重做了數週的樣品。~The illumination beam expander is swapped for a lower magnification, the illumination NA drops and w0 grows from 2 µm to 3 µm; the field gets larger but extra out-of-focus background blurs nuclear boundaries, and with no recorded sheet-thickness acceptance value the researchers blame sample preparation and remake weeks of samples.
units.misconception: 光片越薄越好，做薄不需要付出代價。~A thinner sheet is always better and costs nothing.

units.anchor: 振鏡、電調透鏡與滾動快門~Galvo, tunable lens and rolling shutter
units.title: 掃描光片、軸向掃描與相機同步~Scanned sheets, axial sweeping and camera synchronization
units.mechanism: 光片可以用柱狀透鏡一次形成靜態平面，也可以用振鏡把細光束在焦平面內快速掃過（數位掃描光片），後者強度均勻、可逐行調變，還能做擺動掃描改變入射角，把吸收物造成的條紋陰影平均掉。要突破厚度與視野的取捨，可用電調焦透鏡沿傳播方向移動光束腰，並與 sCMOS 相機的滾動快門同步，讓每一列像素只在光束腰經過時曝光，整個視野都用最薄的那段光片成像。代價是同步時序變成關鍵規格，振鏡、透鏡與相機的觸發抖動直接變成厚度誤差。~A sheet can be formed statically by a cylindrical lens or by a galvanometer sweeping a thin beam rapidly across the focal plane (a digitally scanned light sheet); the latter is uniform, modulable line by line and can pivot to change the incidence angle, averaging away stripe shadows behind absorbers. To break the thickness-versus-field trade-off, an electrically tunable lens moves the waist along the propagation direction in sync with an sCMOS rolling shutter so each pixel row is exposed only while the waist passes, imaging the whole field with the thinnest part of the sheet. The price is that synchronization timing becomes a key specification, and trigger jitter among galvo, lens and camera turns directly into thickness error.
units.model: 40×、6.5 µm 像素，樣品端 0.1625 µm/列，2048 列視野 333 µm。w0 = 2 µm（照明 NA ≈ λ/(πw0) ≈ 0.078）的光束腰掃過整個視野，只讓寬 z_R ≈ 34 µm（約 211 列）的快門狹縫曝光，狹縫內最大寬度 √1.25·w0 ≈ 1.12w0；同樣 w0 的靜態光片只涵蓋 68 µm。每幀 100 ms 時光束腰移動 3.33 mm/s，每列 48.8 µs，觸發抖動須遠小於此值。~With 40× and 6.5 µm pixels the sample-side row pitch is 0.1625 µm and 2048 rows span 333 µm. A waist of w0 = 2 µm (illumination NA ≈ λ/(πw0) ≈ 0.078) swept across the field with a shutter slit only z_R ≈ 34 µm wide (about 211 rows) keeps the maximum width within √1.25·w0 ≈ 1.12w0, whereas a static sheet of the same w0 covers only 68 µm. At 100 ms per frame the waist moves at 3.33 mm/s, 48.8 µs per row, so trigger jitter must be far smaller.
units.verify: 在均勻螢光樣品中改變滾動快門與電調透鏡之間的延遲，量影像亮度與軸向 PSF 對延遲的曲線，找出最佳相位與容許範圍；以示波器同時記錄相機列觸發、電調透鏡驅動與振鏡位置訊號，確認抖動小於數微秒；最後在螢光珠凝膠中檢查全視野軸向 PSF 的一致性。~In a uniformly fluorescent sample vary the delay between rolling shutter and tunable lens and plot image brightness and axial PSF against delay to find the optimum phase and its tolerance; record camera row trigger, tunable-lens drive and galvo position together on an oscilloscope to confirm jitter of a few microseconds or less; finally check axial-PSF uniformity across the field in a bead gel.
units.failure: 電調焦透鏡長時間運轉後升溫、焦距漂移，光束腰與快門狹縫逐漸錯開，影像一側變暗、軸向解析度在視野一端劣化 40%；因為漂移緩慢，只在下午的實驗出現，被誤認為樣品褪色。~After hours of operation the tunable lens warms and its focal power drifts, the waist gradually slips out of step with the shutter slit, one side of the image darkens and axial resolution degrades by 40% at one end of the field; because the drift is slow it appears only in afternoon experiments and is mistaken for sample fading.
units.misconception: 光片顯微鏡的視野只由偵測物鏡與相機決定。~The light-sheet field is set only by the detection objective and camera.

units.anchor: 偵測物鏡與 sCMOS 取樣~Detection objective and sCMOS sampling
units.title: 偵測光路、取樣與等效軸向解析度~Detection path, sampling and effective axial resolution
units.mechanism: 偵測端本身是一台寬場顯微鏡：物鏡 NA 決定橫向解析度與景深，相機像素換算到樣品端的大小決定是否滿足奈奎斯特取樣。光片系統的軸向點擴散函數是照明光片剖面與偵測軸向 PSF 的乘積，兩者都影響軸向解析度：低 NA 偵測的大視野系統由光片厚度主導，高 NA 偵測時由偵測景深主導，光片則負責壓抑焦外背景。偵測物鏡必須浸在樣品槽介質中，工作距離、物鏡外殼角度與照明物鏡的幾何干涉限制了可用的 NA 組合。~The detection side is itself a widefield microscope: objective NA sets lateral resolution and depth of field, and camera pixel size referred to the sample decides whether Nyquist sampling is met. The axial point-spread function of a light-sheet system is the product of the sheet profile and the detection axial PSF, so both affect axial resolution: large-field systems with low-NA detection are dominated by sheet thickness, while high-NA detection is dominated by detection depth of field and the sheet mainly suppresses out-of-focus background. The detection objective must dip into the chamber medium, and working distance, nosepiece angle and geometric interference with the illumination objective limit the usable NA combinations.
units.model: 偵測 NA 0.8 水浸、發射 520 nm：橫向解析度 0.61λ/NA ≈ 0.40 µm，奈奎斯特像素須 ≤ 0.20 µm，40× 搭配 6.5 µm 像素為 0.1625 µm，合格。偵測軸向 FWHM ≈ 2nλ/NA² = 2×1.33×0.52/0.64 ≈ 2.16 µm，光片 FWHM 2.35 µm；兩個高斯相乘時 1/FWHM² 相加，等效軸向 FWHM = 1/√(1/2.16² + 1/2.35²) ≈ 1.59 µm，比任一單獨值都小。~With NA 0.8 water-immersion detection at 520 nm emission, lateral resolution is 0.61λ/NA ≈ 0.40 µm and Nyquist needs pixels ≤ 0.20 µm; 40× with 6.5 µm pixels gives 0.1625 µm, which passes. The detection axial FWHM ≈ 2nλ/NA² = 2×1.33×0.52/0.64 ≈ 2.16 µm and the sheet FWHM is 2.35 µm; multiplying two Gaussians adds 1/FWHM², so the effective axial FWHM = 1/√(1/2.16² + 1/2.35²) ≈ 1.59 µm, smaller than either alone.
units.verify: 以凝膠中的 100 nm 螢光珠取 3D 影像，擬合橫向與軸向 FWHM，扣除珠徑後與模型比較（橫向預期約 0.41 µm）；以已知節距的網格校正放大率與像素尺寸；把光片移離焦平面量軸向 PSF 隨偏移的變化，分離偵測與照明各自的貢獻。~Image 100 nm beads in gel in 3D, fit lateral and axial FWHM and compare with the model after accounting for bead size (about 0.41 µm expected laterally); calibrate magnification and pixel size against a grid of known pitch; step the sheet away from the focal plane and measure how the axial PSF changes to separate detection and illumination contributions.
units.failure: 為了加快速度把相機像素合併 2×2，樣品端像素變成 0.325 µm，超過 0.20 µm 的奈奎斯特限制，細胞膜與細絲出現鋸齒與混疊；研究者量到的絲狀結構寬度系統性偏寬，卻以為是生物變異。~To speed up acquisition the camera is binned 2×2, the sample-side pixel becomes 0.325 µm, beyond the 0.20 µm Nyquist limit, and membranes and filaments show jagged aliasing; the filament widths researchers measure are systematically too large and are read as biological variation.
units.misconception: 光片的厚度就是系統的軸向解析度。~The sheet thickness is the system's axial resolution.

units.anchor: 光片傾角與焦平面共面~Sheet tilt and focal-plane coplanarity
units.title: 光片與焦平面的對位校正~Aligning the sheet to the focal plane
units.mechanism: 光片必須與偵測物鏡的焦平面完全共面：光片中心偏離焦平面會讓訊號下降、背景上升；光片相對焦平面有傾角時，視野一側在焦內、另一側在焦外。校正通常用螢光珠或均勻螢光樣品，依序調整光片高度（照明側振鏡偏移）、傾角（與物鏡後焦面共軛的振鏡或鏡座）與光束腰位置（照明物鏡或電調透鏡），每一項都以影像銳利度或珠的軸向 PSF 為指標。雙側照明時兩片光必須分別對位，並確認兩者在中央重合。~The sheet must be exactly coplanar with the detection focal plane: a sheet centre offset from focus lowers signal and raises background, and a sheet tilted relative to focus leaves one side of the field sharp and the other blurred. Calibration usually uses beads or a uniform fluorescent sample, adjusting in turn sheet height (an illumination galvo offset), tilt (a galvo or mount conjugate to the objective back focal plane) and waist position (the illumination objective or tunable lens), each judged by image sharpness or bead axial PSF. With dual-sided illumination both sheets are aligned separately and confirmed to coincide at the centre.
units.model: 偵測景深 nλ/NA² = 1.33×0.52/0.64 ≈ 1.08 µm，容許偏離 ±0.54 µm。在 333 µm 視野的半寬 166 µm 上，傾角須小於 0.54/166 ≈ 3.2 mrad（0.19°）。照明物鏡焦距 20 mm、振鏡與後焦面共軛（放大率 1）時光片位移 = f·θ，0.54 µm 只對應 27 µrad 的振鏡角度，振鏡解析度與溫度漂移都必須低於這個等級。~Detection depth of field nλ/NA² = 1.33×0.52/0.64 ≈ 1.08 µm allows an offset of ±0.54 µm. Over the 166 µm half-width of a 333 µm field the tilt must be below 0.54/166 ≈ 3.2 mrad (0.19°). With a 20 mm illumination-objective focal length and a galvo conjugate to the back focal plane at unit magnification, sheet displacement = f·θ, so 0.54 µm corresponds to only 27 µrad of galvo angle, and galvo resolution and thermal drift must both stay below that level.
units.verify: 在螢光珠凝膠上以振鏡偏移掃描光片位置，記錄視野左、中、右三區的平均珠亮度，三條曲線峰值位置之差即反映傾角，修正後應小於 0.3 µm；開機後 1 小時內每 10 分鐘重複一次，記錄振鏡與機構的熱漂移曲線。~On a bead gel scan the sheet position with the galvo offset and record mean bead brightness in the left, centre and right of the field; the spread of the three curve peaks reveals the tilt and should be below 0.3 µm after correction; repeat every 10 minutes during the first hour after start-up to log galvo and mechanical thermal drift.
units.failure: 樣品槽換新後窗片厚度不同，照明光進入介質時的折射使光片高度偏移 3 µm，所有影像都偏暗偏糊；操作者以提高雷射功率補償，漂白因此加速，而真正需要的只是重新對位。~A new sample chamber has a different window thickness, refraction where the illumination enters the medium shifts the sheet height by 3 µm and every image is dim and soft; the operator compensates with more laser power, accelerating bleaching, when all that was needed was realignment.
units.misconception: 光片在組裝時對準一次，之後就不必再校正。~A sheet aligned once at assembly never needs recalibration.

units.anchor: 散射、陰影與折射率失配~Scattering, shadows and index mismatch
units.title: 散射、吸收與折射率失配的誤差預算~Error budget for scattering, absorption and index mismatch
units.mechanism: 光片從側面穿過樣品，深處的光要先經過前方組織：散射把彈道光子轉成背景並讓光片變厚，吸收物（色素、卵黃）在其後方投下條紋陰影。樣品折射率與浸潤介質不同時，偵測物鏡看到的焦平面隨深度漂移，光片與焦平面逐漸分離。對策包括雙側照明（每側只負責一半寬度）、擺動掃描、多角度取像，以及組織透明化搭配折射率相符的介質；活體大樣品則需要隨深度動態補償焦距。~The sheet crosses the sample from the side, so light reaching deep regions must first pass through the tissue in front: scattering converts ballistic photons into background and thickens the sheet, and absorbers such as pigment or yolk cast stripe shadows behind them. When sample and immersion medium differ in refractive index, the focal plane seen by the detection objective drifts with depth and the sheet and focal plane separate. Remedies include dual-sided illumination with each side covering half the width, pivot scanning, multi-angle acquisition and tissue clearing with index-matched media, while large live samples need depth-dependent focus compensation.
units.model: 散射長度 ls = 100 µm（教學假設）、樣品寬 600 µm：單側照明到對側路徑 600 µm，彈道比例 e⁻⁶ ≈ 0.25%；雙側照明最遠 300 µm，e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%，提高 20 倍。折射率失配：樣品 n = 1.45 置於水 n = 1.33，焦平面漂移率 1.45/1.33 − 1 ≈ 0.090，深入 50 µm 就偏 4.5 µm，是 1.08 µm 景深的 4 倍，2 mm 深時達 180 µm。~With a scattering length ls = 100 µm (teaching assumption) and a 600 µm wide sample, single-sided illumination travels 600 µm to the far side for a ballistic fraction of e⁻⁶ ≈ 0.25%; dual-sided illumination travels at most 300 µm for e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%, twenty times more. For index mismatch, a sample of n = 1.45 in water at n = 1.33 drifts the focal plane at 1.45/1.33 − 1 ≈ 0.090, so 50 µm deep it is off by 4.5 µm, four times the 1.08 µm depth of field, and 2 mm deep by 180 µm.
units.verify: 在加入散射微球的凝膠仿體中量光片厚度與訊號隨深度的衰減並擬合 ls；以分布在不同深度的螢光珠量最佳焦距對深度的曲線，斜率應接近 n_s/n_m − 1，據此建立動態補償表；比較單側、雙側與擺動掃描下影像條紋的對比。~In a gel phantom loaded with scattering microspheres measure sheet thickness and signal decay with depth and fit ls; with beads at several depths measure best focus versus depth, whose slope should approach n_s/n_m − 1, and build the dynamic compensation table from it; compare stripe contrast in single-sided, dual-sided and pivot-scanned images.
units.failure: 改用折射率 1.52 的新清除液，樣品槽卻仍裝 1.45 的浸潤介質並沿用舊補償表，失配率 0.048 使 2 mm 深處焦平面偏約 97 µm，影像越深越糊；深層細胞計數系統性偏低，被誤報為腦區之間的生物差異。~A new clearing agent at n = 1.52 is adopted while the chamber still holds 1.45 immersion medium with the old compensation table, so a 0.048 mismatch shifts focus by about 97 µm at 2 mm depth and images blur with depth; deep cell counts come out systematically low and are reported as biological differences between brain regions.
units.misconception: 樣品透明之後，深處影像就和表面一樣清楚。~Once a sample is cleared, deep images are as sharp as the surface.

units.anchor: 多視角融合與資料管線~Multiview fusion and data pipeline
units.title: 多視角融合與資料管線整合~Multiview fusion and data-pipeline integration
units.mechanism: 單一視角的光片影像軸向解析度比橫向差數倍，深處又受散射與陰影影響。多視角取像把樣品旋轉或用多支物鏡從不同方向拍同一體積，以嵌入的螢光珠或影像特徵配準，再以加權平均或多視角反摺積融合，得到接近等向的解析度與完整覆蓋。整合時資料量往往才是真正的瓶頸：sCMOS 相機持續以數百 MB/s 輸出，需要串流寫入磁碟陣列、即時壓縮與自動化的配準融合流程，否則長時間縮時實驗無法收尾。~A single-view light-sheet image has axial resolution several times worse than lateral, and deep regions suffer scattering and shadows. Multiview acquisition rotates the sample or uses several objectives to record the same volume from different directions, registers the views with embedded beads or image features, then fuses them by weighted averaging or multiview deconvolution for near-isotropic resolution and complete coverage. In integration the data volume is often the real bottleneck: sCMOS cameras stream hundreds of MB/s continuously, demanding streaming to disk arrays, on-the-fly compression and automated registration and fusion, without which long time-lapse experiments cannot be completed.
units.model: 2048×2048、16 bit、100 fps 相機輸出 2048²×2 B×100 ≈ 839 MB/s，雙相機約 1.68 GB/s。每 30 秒取 400 層、連續 24 小時共 2880 個體積，單相機資料 2880×400×8.39 MB ≈ 9.7 TB。四視角融合後軸向解析度由約 1.6 µm 向橫向的 0.4 µm 靠近，但配準誤差須小於橫向解析度的一半，即約 0.2 µm。~A 2048×2048, 16-bit camera at 100 fps outputs 2048²×2 B×100 ≈ 839 MB/s, and two cameras about 1.68 GB/s. Taking 400 planes every 30 s for 24 hours gives 2880 volumes and 2880×400×8.39 MB ≈ 9.7 TB per camera. Four-view fusion moves axial resolution from about 1.6 µm toward the lateral 0.4 µm, but registration error must stay below half the lateral resolution, about 0.2 µm.
units.verify: 以嵌入次解析度螢光珠的樣品從四個角度取像，用珠位置配準並計算殘差均方根，應小於 0.2 µm；比較單視角與融合後珠的 3D FWHM；長時間取像中監控寫入頻寬、緩衝區占用與掉幀數，確認儲存系統持續寫入速度至少是相機輸出的 1.5 倍。~Image a sample with embedded sub-resolution beads from four angles, register on bead positions and compute the residual rms, which should be below 0.2 µm; compare bead 3D FWHM in single views and the fusion; during long acquisitions monitor write bandwidth, buffer occupancy and dropped frames, confirming that sustained storage throughput is at least 1.5 times the camera output.
units.failure: 磁碟陣列持續寫入只有 700 MB/s，前幾分鐘靠記憶體緩衝看不出問題，數十分鐘後開始隨機掉幀，時間序列出現缺口，配準演算法把缺幀當成樣品突然移動，融合結果出現鬼影。~The disk array sustains only 700 MB/s; memory buffering hides it for the first few minutes, then frames drop at random after tens of minutes, the time series develops gaps, the registration algorithm reads missing frames as sudden sample motion and the fused result shows ghosts.
units.misconception: 光片實驗的限制主要在光學，資料處理只是後續小事。~Optics is the main limit; data handling is a minor afterthought.

units.anchor: 螢光珠驗收與交接紀錄~Bead acceptance and handoff record
units.title: 系統驗收與工程交接~System acceptance and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 光片顯微鏡的驗收把前面每個模型變成量測：視野多處螢光珠的橫向與軸向 FWHM 驗證偵測解析度與光片均勻性；光片側影驗證 w0、z_R 與腰的位置；共面性掃描驗證傾角；觸發時序驗證同步；重複取像驗證漂白率與熱漂移；連續寫入測試驗證資料管線。交接紀錄必須包含每一組物鏡、介質與光片設定下的校正值，因為換介質、換樣品槽或換波長都會讓舊值失效。~Light-sheet acceptance turns each earlier model into a measurement: lateral and axial bead FWHM at many field positions verify detection resolution and sheet uniformity; the sheet profile verifies w0, z_R and waist position; a coplanarity scan verifies tilt; trigger timing verifies synchronization; repeated acquisition verifies bleach rate and thermal drift; a sustained write test verifies the data pipeline. The handoff record must hold calibration values for every combination of objective, medium and sheet setting, because a change of medium, chamber or wavelength invalidates the old values.
units.model: 100 nm 珠橫向 FWHM 預期 √(0.397² + 0.1²) ≈ 0.41 µm，量得 0.42 µm；中心軸向預期 1.59 µm，量得 1.63 µm。靜態高斯光片在視野邊緣（z_R 處）光片 FWHM 變 3.33 µm，等效軸向 1.81 µm，邊緣／中心比 1.14；軸向掃描模式最大光片 FWHM 2.63 µm，比值應 ≤ 1.05。傾角 < 0.19°、觸發抖動 < 5 µs；24 小時 2880 疊後要保留一半訊號，每疊漂白須 ≤ 1 − 0.5^(1/2880) ≈ 0.024%。~Expected lateral FWHM for 100 nm beads is √(0.397² + 0.1²) ≈ 0.41 µm, measured 0.42 µm; expected centre axial 1.59 µm, measured 1.63 µm. A static Gaussian sheet at the field edge (at z_R) widens to 3.33 µm FWHM for an effective axial 1.81 µm, an edge-to-centre ratio of 1.14; in axial-sweep mode the maximum sheet FWHM is 2.63 µm and the ratio should be ≤ 1.05. Tilt < 0.19°, trigger jitter < 5 µs; keeping half the signal after 2880 stacks in 24 hours needs bleaching per stack ≤ 1 − 0.5^(1/2880) ≈ 0.024%.
units.verify: 依固定順序：熱平衡 1 小時；光片側影量 w0 與腰位置；螢光珠樣品在 3×3 個位置量 3D PSF；共面性掃描；示波器量觸發時序；同一樣品取 50 疊量漂白率；連續 1 小時全速寫入測試。全部數值與模型並列填表，任何超出允收者記錄原因與重新校正的結果。~In a fixed order: one hour of thermal settling; sheet profile for w0 and waist position; 3D PSFs of beads at 3×3 field positions; coplanarity scan; trigger timing on an oscilloscope; 50 stacks of one sample for bleach rate; a one-hour full-speed write test. Tabulate every value beside its model, and record cause and recalibration result for anything outside the allowance.
units.failure: 驗收只在視野中央量珠 PSF，邊緣因光束腰偏離中心 30 µm，軸向解析度差了 25%；使用者在邊緣量細胞體積系統性偏大，而交接紀錄沒有腰位置資料，無法追溯是哪次維修後發生的。~Acceptance measured bead PSFs only at the field centre, while a waist displaced 30 µm from centre leaves axial resolution 25% worse at the edge; users measuring cell volumes there get systematically large values, and with no waist position in the handoff record nobody can trace which service visit caused it.
units.misconception: 中央的螢光珠合格，就代表整個視野都合格。~If beads at the centre pass, the whole field passes.

example: 光片設計練習：以 40×/0.8 水浸偵測物鏡為斑馬魚胚胎成像，視野 333 µm、λ = 488 nm。靜態高斯光片要涵蓋全視野需 z_R = 166 µm，w0 = √(166×0.488/(π×1.33)) ≈ 4.4 µm，光片 FWHM ≈ 5.2 µm，等效軸向 FWHM = 1/√(1/2.16² + 1/5.2²) ≈ 2.0 µm，光片厚度約為 1.08 µm 景深的 4.8 倍，焦外背景高。改用 w0 = 2 µm 的軸向掃描光片：快門狹縫 211 列，最大光片 FWHM 2.63 µm，等效軸向 ≤ 1.67 µm，厚度／景深比降到 2.4。每幀 50 ms、2 µm 步距取 200 層，每疊 10 s，可容納 30 s 間隔；每疊資料 200×8.39 MB ≈ 1.68 GB，24 小時 2880 疊約 4.8 TB。若 24 小時後要保留一半訊號，每疊漂白須 ≤ 0.024%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Light-sheet design exercise: imaging a zebrafish embryo with a 40×/0.8 water-immersion detection objective over a 333 µm field at λ = 488 nm. A static Gaussian sheet covering the field needs z_R = 166 µm, w0 = √(166×0.488/(π×1.33)) ≈ 4.4 µm and a sheet FWHM ≈ 5.2 µm, giving an effective axial FWHM = 1/√(1/2.16² + 1/5.2²) ≈ 2.0 µm with a sheet 4.8 times the 1.08 µm depth of field and heavy out-of-focus background. An axially swept sheet with w0 = 2 µm uses a 211-row shutter slit, a maximum sheet FWHM of 2.63 µm and an effective axial FWHM ≤ 1.67 µm, cutting the thickness-to-depth-of-field ratio to 2.4. At 50 ms per frame and a 2 µm step, 200 planes take 10 s per stack, fitting a 30 s interval; each stack holds 200×8.39 MB ≈ 1.68 GB and 2880 stacks in 24 hours about 4.8 TB. Keeping half the signal after 24 hours requires bleaching ≤ 0.024% per stack. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1903 年 Siedentopf 與 Zsigmondy 的超顯微鏡以側向照明觀察膠體金粒子，是正交照明的起點；1993 年 Voie 等人以 OPFOS 對透明化耳蝸做光片切片成像。2004 年 EMBL 的 Huisken、Stelzer 等人發表 SPIM，在活體胚胎上展示低光毒性的長時間 3D 成像；2008 年 Keller 等人以數位掃描光片記錄斑馬魚胚胎發育；2011 年 Betzig 團隊引入貝索光束平面照明，2014 年在 Janelia 發表晶格光片顯微鏡；2019 年 mesoSPIM 計畫公開了透明化組織用的大視野軸向掃描光片設計。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~In 1903 Siedentopf and Zsigmondy's ultramicroscope used side illumination to observe colloidal gold particles, the origin of orthogonal illumination; in 1993 Voie and colleagues used OPFOS to image optical sections of a cleared cochlea with a light sheet. In 2004 Huisken, Stelzer and colleagues at EMBL published SPIM, demonstrating long-term low-phototoxicity 3D imaging of live embryos; in 2008 Keller and colleagues recorded zebrafish embryo development with a digitally scanned light sheet; in 2011 Betzig's team introduced Bessel-beam plane illumination and in 2014 published the lattice light-sheet microscope at Janelia; in 2019 the mesoSPIM initiative released a large-field axially scanned light-sheet design for cleared tissue. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

sources.scopeEn: Institutional page describing the lattice light-sheet microscope developed by Betzig's team, illuminating one thin sheet at a time with low phototoxicity for multi-hour multicolour 3D imaging, shared through the Advanced Imaging Center; course numbers are teaching assumptions.

sources.scopeEn: Official product page describing illumination perpendicular to detection, pivot scanning to reduce shadow stripes, live-imaging incubation chambers and chambers for cleared samples from refractive index 1.33 to 1.58; no internal design parameters.

sources.scope: 同儕審查論文紀錄，介紹以電調焦透鏡軸向掃描光束腰並與相機滾動快門同步的開源大視野光片顯微鏡；課程中的同步時序數值為教學假設。
sources.scopeEn: Peer-reviewed paper record introducing open-source large-field light-sheet microscopes that sweep the waist axially with a tunable lens synchronized to the camera rolling shutter; the course's timing numbers are teaching assumptions.
